subject: Post-call recap: data role mapping, SCC module selection & next steps
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <m.gonzalez@helioshealth.com>, procurement@helioshealth.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: data role mapping, SCC module selection & next steps

Hi Maria / Helios team,

Thanks again for taking time today — quick recap and clear next steps so we stay aligned while legal/security review the paperwork. Short version up front: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II (report available), we support HIPAA controls and can operate as a processor under a standard DPA + SCCs. I've attached three artifacts for your intake team.

Key call notes:
- Helios confirmed EU customer base; cross-border transfers to U.S. likely (so SCCs will be required).
- Helios expects Redwood to act as Data Processor; Helios will remain Controller.
- SOC 2 status: report available on request; we are not a HIPAA-covered entity but will sign BAAs where necessary with appropriate controls.

Attachments I included here:
- Redwood_DPA_options_v1.pdf (short DPA + two SCC module templates)
- SCC_module_matrix.xlsx (what modules map to typical transfer scenarios)
- Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Helios_Template.docx (we can pre-fill answers where helpful)

Open questions we flagged for Helios (please confirm):
1) Desired SCC module: Module 1 (controller-processor) vs Module 2 (controller-controller) vs dual path? If Helios wants us listed as Processor, Module 1 is typically correct.
2) Any specific retention or deletion commitments beyond our standard 90-day KV retention?
3) Timeline: Helios asked for a DPA + SCC draft by next Friday (2026-08-13). Is that still the target?

Proposed next steps (from Redwood):
- I will circulate our draft DPA + recommended SCC module (see attachment) and a pre-filled vendor questionnaire by EOD tomorrow.
- Helios to confirm controller/processor alignment and any bespoke clauses (e.g., audit access, subprocessors list).
- Legal teams to schedule a short call if redlines are expected.

Action owners:
- Helios (Maria / procurement): confirm controller/processor and target SCC module (reply here).
- Helios: return vendor questionnaire with any gaps by 2026-08-10 if possible.
- Redwood (Priyom): prepare DPA + SCC draft and pre-filled questionnaire (cc'd).

Thanks — I’ll send the materials next.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sales Director, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187

From: Maria Gonzalez <m.gonzalez@helioshealth.com>

Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 09:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: data role mapping, SCC module selection & next steps

Thanks Laura — appreciate the recap and quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Controller/Processor: Helios' default position is that our customers remain Controllers and vendors like Redwood are Processors. We do have some contracts where both parties are Controllers (co-controller) for shared datasets, but today we anticipate Processor role for Redwood.

2) SCC modules: because data will be transferred to the U.S., we typically ask for Module 1 (Controller to Processor) SCCs. We occasionally ask for Module 2 in limited partner scenarios, but Module 1 should be sufficient. Can you annotate the workbook with the recommended choice and a short justification?

3) SOC 2 & HIPAA: please send SOC 2 Type II report or AICPA letter; we will want evidence of controls around access, vulnerability management, and incident response. For HIPAA — we may need a BAA later in the procurement process; for now confirm that Redwood will sign BAAs for covered PHI flows.

4) Questionnaire: attached is our security questionnaire template (we've re-attached to this reply). Can you pre-fill answers for the items where Redwood has standard practices? Our target for receiving a complete DPA + SCC draft and pre-filled questionnaire is 13 Aug 2026.

One more logistical note: procurement@helioshealth.com will coordinate PO and procurement-side redlines once legal receives initial drafts.

—Maria
Maria Gonzalez
Head of Information Security
Helios Health
